name: Creativity
definition: You welcome new ideas; you are passionate and persistent in pursuit of more innovative solutions; you value artistic expression.

rows.situation: Someone offers an approach you did not think of
rows.under: Shoots it down because it is unfamiliar, or ignores it.
rows.justRight: Gives it a real hearing, keeps the part that is better, and says why you are dropping the rest.
rows.over: Adopts every new idea on contact, and the work never settles long enough to ship.

rows.situation: A working solution that is only adequate
rows.under: Stops at the first thing that functions.
rows.justRight: Keeps looking for a more innovative solution while the current one still serves people, and ships when the better one is real.
rows.over: Holds the release for a cleverer version that the audience did not need.

rows.situation: An original approach that is not working
rows.under: Drops it at the first objection.
rows.justRight: Stays with it while there is a reason to believe it will work, and stops when the evidence says it will not.
rows.over: Keeps a failed original idea alive because giving it up would feel uncreative.

rows.situation: An idea from someone who does not do this job
rows.under: Dismisses it because of who said it.
rows.justRight: Judges the idea. Uses it when it is good. Does not pretend every outside idea is equally informed.
rows.over: Treats outside novelty as automatically better than the craft of the people who do the work.

rows.situation: Creative work that is not to your taste
rows.under: Blocks it because you would not watch it, read it, or play it.
rows.justRight: Judges whether it is good of its kind, not whether it is for you.
rows.over: Refuses to have a standard at all, and calls every preference censorship.
